items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The drummer’s name was Osie Johnson. He heard me play it one day in the barracks.

ctx.x: Because the audience wanted to hear it? Or what?
No. The drummer’s name was Osie Johnson. He heard me play it one day in the barracks. He say, “You know that solo?” Like a nut, I said yeah.
